subject: Map + security escrow lane — SOC2/SIG/DPA & retention follow-up
messages:
From: Simon Liu <simon.liu@clearhorizonbank.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Asha Rao <asha.rao@clearhorizonbank.com>
Date: 2028-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Security gates & MAP — kickoff

Olga, thanks again for the demo last week. We need to lock the security/compliance lane in our mutual action plan before budgeting next quarter. High level asks from our InfoSec team:
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and a scoped evidence share process
- SIG/CAIQ matrix (or completed CAIQ) — prioritized controls for data handling and model usage
- DPA redline and data residency options (EU residency required for PII processing)
- Data retention policy: transactional records 5 yrs, regulated docs 7 yrs (exceptions possible)
- KMS/HSM integration and key escrow options for long-term retention
- Audit logs & incident response SLAs

I attached our standard security questionnaire (spreadsheet) — please review and propose a MAP with milestones and owners. We have a procurement window targeting a decision by the end of January.

Thanks,
Simon

[Attachment: ClearHorizon_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Liu <simon.liu@clearhorizonbank.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-12-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security gates & MAP — kickoff

Simon — appreciate the clear checklist. Quick read-through and proposed next steps below. I think we can map to a concise MAP (milestones, owners, target dates) that addresses your procurement window. Proposed MAP highlights:
1) Evidence & attestations (owner: Compliance) — deliver SOC 2 Type II report and an evidence intake plan by 2028-12-08. We can provide a controlled evidence bundle (redacted) and a follow-up intake session.
2) SIG/CAIQ (owner: Security Eng) — provide a completed CAIQ + prioritized control matrix by 2028-12-12. For any gaps we’ll propose compensating controls.
3) DPA (owner: Legal) — we’ll accept a redline review cycle; internal target is same-week turnaround for straightforward items. Please share redline and we’ll circulate to Legal.
4) Data residency & retention (owner: Product + Infra) — Redwood Private can host in EU regions; retention policy options and retention escalation/escrow proposal by 2028-12-12.
5) KMS & logs (owner: Infra) — outline KMS/HSM options and key escrow for long-term archived blobs, plus audit-log export cadence, by 2028-12-12.

Meeting: propose a 30m MAP sync the week of 2028-12-11 to align owners and confirm dates. I’ve added Priyom (technical lead) and Neha (compliance lead) to keep things tight.

Olga
Director, Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference)
[Signature]

From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@clearhorizonbank.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Simon Liu <simon.liu@clearhorizonbank.com>, Matt O'Connell <matt.ocon@legalbridge.com>
Date: 2028-12-05T08:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security gates & MAP — kickoff

Thanks Olga — attaching our procurement redline to the DPA (see attached). A few clarifications from Legal and Ops while you put the MAP together:
- Retention: we are firm on 5 years for transaction-level datasets; 7 years for regulatory artifacts. We will want a contractual carveout for legal holds.
- Deletion SLA: 30 days for standard deletion requests; certified removal evidence for regulated docs.
- Key escrow: we need clarity around escrow holder, access conditions, and geo-boundary for escrowed keys.
- Subprocessor transparency and monthly subprocessor report (or quarterly if monthly is not possible).

We can join the 12/11 sync — Simon will confirm time.

[Attachment: DPA_ClearHorizon_redline_20281205.docx (docx)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@clearhorizonbank.com>, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-12-11T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security gates & MAP — technical notes ahead of sync

Asha — quick technical clarifications ahead of tomorrow’s sync:
- EU residency: Redwood Private (VPC) supports hosting in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. For the hosted plan we can provide guaranteed routing to EU regions for PII only if you choose the Private or Dedicated lanes.
- Retention & escrow: we support standard retention windows configurable per-tenant. For the 7-year retention we recommend an encrypted archive tier with customer-managed keys. Key escrow options: (1) Redwood-managed KMS with escrow agreement, (2) customer-provided KMS with HSM key import, (3) third-party escrow (we can propose partners).
- Deletion SLA: standard platform deletion is 30 days for removal from active indexes; we provide certified purge reports for archival tiers within 45 days (we can commit to 30 days for scoped regulated artifacts with contractual language).
- SIG/CAIQ: we will supply the CAIQ + a short control-gap table that maps to your top-10 controls (will surface compensating controls where needed).

I attached a short tech appendix (draft) that we’ll circulate after the call. Priyom

[Attachment: RH_technical_appendix_retention_escrow_draft.pdf (pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Liu <simon.liu@clearhorizonbank.com>, Asha Rao <asha.rao@clearhorizonbank.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, matt.ocon@legalbridge.com
Date: 2028-12-12T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: MAP deliverables & owners — snapshot after sync (action items)

Thanks everyone for the call — summary and agreed MAP snapshot below (owners + target dates). Please reply with any corrections.

MAP snapshot (agreed):
- SOC 2 Type II report + evidence intake session — Owner: Compliance (Neha). Target: 2028-12-08 (delivered, evidence intake scheduled).
- CAIQ + prioritized control matrix — Owner: Security Eng (Jonas). Target: 2028-12-12 (delivered as draft).
- DPA redline review & legal commit — Owner: Legal (Matt / Redwood Legal). Action: Redwood to produce a response to redline by 2028-12-19; final sign expected during procurement window.
- Retention policy: transactional 5y, regulated 7y; legal hold carveouts — Owner: Product + Infra (Priyom). Target: proposal & escrow options 2028-12-12 (proposal delivered in tech appendix).
- KMS & key escrow options: Owner: Infra (Priyom). Action: follow-up doc with recommended escrow partner and proposed contract language by 2028-12-18.
- Deletion SLA: commit to 30-day certified deletion for scoped regulated artifacts (contractual).
- Subprocessor cadence: Redwood to propose quarterly subprocessor reports; can support monthly on request (operational note).

Open items for ClearHorizon to confirm:
1) Which key-escrow model preferred (redwood-managed, customer KMS import, or 3rd-party escrow)?
2) Any additional retention carveouts beyond legal holds?
3) Confirm go/no-go date for the procurement board (you mentioned end of January).

Next steps:
- I’ll upload the MAP draft + tech appendix to the shared Drive link and post a HubSpot update (links below).
- Redwood Legal will send the DPA response by 2028-12-19.

Can you confirm the preferred escrow model and whether the MAP timeline satisfies your procurement committee? If helpful, we can create a short one-page MAP that ties the security gates to the procurement checklist.

Olga
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
